units.source_text: 观水型插花已经扬好了。

en.t: The water-viewing style flower arrangement had already been set up.

units.source_text: 水盘右侧，木贼草的直线和燕子花叶的纯洁的曲线相交，一朵花儿已经绽开，其他两朵宿营含苞待放。

en.t: On the right side of the water basin, the straight lines of the horsetail grass crossed the pure curves of the iris leaves; one flower had already opened, while the other two were still in bud.

units.source_text: 这盘插花摆在小壁龛里，几乎占满了整个空地。

en.t: This flower arrangement was placed in the small alcove, almost filling the whole empty space.

units.source_text: 投在水盆里的水面上的影子十分平静，掩藏着"剑山"的大粒砂子呈现出一派明澄的水边的风情。

en.t: The shadows cast on the surface of the water in the basin were perfectly calm, and the coarse grains of sand hiding the kenzan gave the scene the clear, bright feeling of a waterside.
